sanskrit: pra parva̍tānām uśa̱tī u̱pasthā̱d aśve̍ iva̱ viṣi̍te̱ hāsa̍māne | gāve̍va śu̱bhre mā̱tarā̍ rihā̱ṇe vipā̍ṭ chutu̱drī paya̍sā javete ||
english: Rushing forth eager from the lap of the mountains, like two mares let loose racing side by side, like two bright mother-cows licking their calves, Vipāś and Śutudrī speed on with their waters.

sanskrit: indre̍ṣite prasa̱vam bhikṣa̍māṇe̱ acchā̍ samu̱draṁ ra̱thye̍va yāthaḥ | sa̱mā̱rā̱ṇe ū̱rmibhi̱ḥ pinva̍māne a̱nyā vā̍m a̱nyām apy e̍ti śubhre ||
english: Urged by Indra, seeking your forward flow, you move toward the ocean like chariot-wheels on a road. Swelling with waves as you join together, one of you shining ones overtakes the other.

sanskrit: acchā̱ sindhu̍m mā̱tṛta̍mām ayāsa̱ṁ vipā̍śam u̱rvīṁ su̱bhagā̍m aganma | va̱tsam i̍va mā̱tarā̍ saṁrihā̱ṇe sa̍mā̱naṁ yoni̱m anu̍ sa̱ṁcara̍ntī ||
english: I came to the most motherly Sindhu, to broad and blessed Vipāś. Like two mothers licking a calf, they flow together along the same common channel.

sanskrit: e̱nā va̱yam paya̍sā̱ pinva̍mānā̱ anu̱ yoni̍ṁ de̱vakṛ̍ta̱ṁ cara̍ntīḥ | na varta̍ve prasa̱vaḥ sarga̍taktaḥ ki̱ṁyur vipro̍ na̱dyo̍ johavīti ||
english: Swelling with these waters, flowing along the god-made channel — the current once released in a torrent cannot be turned back. What does the inspired poet repeatedly call out to the rivers?

sanskrit: rama̍dhvam me̱ vaca̍se so̱myāya̱ ṛtā̍varī̱r upa̍ muhū̱rtam evai̍ḥ | pra sindhu̱m acchā̍ bṛha̱tī ma̍nī̱ṣāva̱syur a̍hve kuśi̱kasya̍ sū̱nuḥ ||
english: Yield to my Soma-blessed speech, O holy rivers, just for a moment! Desiring help, seeking the Sindhu, with great prayer the son of Kuśika called out.

sanskrit: indro̍ a̱smām̐ a̍rada̱d vajra̍bāhu̱r apā̍han vṛ̱tram pa̍ri̱dhiṁ na̱dīnā̍m | de̱vo̍ 'nayat savi̱tā su̍pā̱ṇis tasya̍ va̱yam pra̍sa̱ve yā̍ma u̱rvīḥ ||
english: Indra of the thunderbolt arm split open a way for us; he smote Vṛtra, the barrier of the rivers. Savitṛ the god with fair hands led them; in his impulsion we, the broad ones, flow on.

sanskrit: pra̱vācya̍ṁ śaśva̱dhā vī̱rya1̱̍ṁ tad indra̍sya̱ karma̱ yad ahi̍ṁ vivṛ̱ścat | vi vajre̍ṇa pari̱ṣado̍ jaghā̱nāya̱nn āpo 'ya̍nam i̱cchamā̍nāḥ ||
english: Ever worth proclaiming is that heroic deed of Indra — that he cleft the serpent asunder. He shattered with the bolt the barriers encircling them, and the waters rushed forth seeking their path.

sanskrit: e̱tad vaco̍ jarita̱r māpi̍ mṛṣṭhā̱ ā yat te̱ ghoṣā̱n utta̍rā yu̱gāni̍ | u̱ktheṣu̍ kāro̱ prati̍ no juṣasva̱ mā no̱ ni ka̍ḥ puruṣa̱trā nama̍s te ||
english: O singer, do not forget this word, when your cries rise up through future ages. Favor us in your hymns, O singer; do not cast us down among men. Homage to you!

sanskrit: o ṣu sva̍sāraḥ kā̱rave̍ śṛṇota ya̱yau vo̍ dū̱rād ana̍sā̱ rathe̍na | ni ṣū na̍madhva̱m bhava̍tā supā̱rā a̍dhoa̱kṣāḥ si̍ndhavaḥ sro̱tyābhi̍ḥ ||
english: Listen, O sister rivers, to the singer who has traveled to you from afar with cart and chariot. Bow down, become easy to cross — with your axles low, O rivers, fordable by their currents.

sanskrit: ā te̍ kāro śṛṇavāmā̱ vacā̍ṁsi ya̱yātha̍ dū̱rād ana̍sā̱ rathe̍na | ni te̍ naṁsai pīpyā̱neva̱ yoṣā̱ maryā̍yeva ka̱nyā̍ śaśva̱cai te̍ ||
english: We hear your words, O singer — you who have come from afar with cart and chariot. I shall bow low to you like a woman swelling with milk, like a maiden ever yielding to the young man.

sanskrit: yad a̱ṅga tvā̍ bhara̱tāḥ sa̱ṁtare̍yur ga̱vyan grāma̍ iṣi̱ta indra̍jūtaḥ | arṣā̱d aha̍ prasa̱vaḥ sarga̍takta̱ ā vo̍ vṛṇe suma̱tiṁ ya̱jñiyā̍nām ||
english: When the Bharatas, the cattle-seeking host, impelled and goaded by Indra, shall cross you, then let the current flow on, released in a rush — I choose your benevolence, O holy ones.

sanskrit: atā̍riṣur bhara̱tā ga̱vyava̱ḥ sam abha̍kta̱ vipra̍ḥ suma̱tiṁ na̱dīnā̍m | pra pi̍nvadhvam i̱ṣaya̍ntīḥ su̱rādhā̍ā va̱kṣaṇā̍ḥ pṛ̱ṇadhva̍ṁ yā̱ta śībha̍m ||
english: The Bharatas seeking cattle have crossed; the inspired one has won the benevolence of the rivers. Swell onward, nourishing and generous; fill your channels and flow swiftly!

sanskrit: ud va̍ ū̱rmiḥ śamyā̍ ha̱ntv āpo̱ yoktrā̍ṇi muñcata | mādu̍ṣkṛtau̱ vye̍nasā̱ghnyau śūna̱m āra̍tām ||
english: Let the Śamyā's wave strike up for you, O waters — release the bonds! May the two sin-cleansing, guiltless cows not weary and come to grief!

sanskrit: indra̍ḥ pū̱rbhid āti̍ra̱d dāsa̍m a̱rkair vi̱dadv asu̱r daya̍māno̱ vi śatrū̍n | brahma̍jūtas ta̱nvā̍ vāvṛdhā̱no bhūri̍dātra̱ āpṛ̍ṇa̱d roda̍sī u̱bhe ||
english: Indra, the fort-cleaver, overpowered the Dāsa with his rays, winning wealth, distributing it among enemies. Impelled by prayer, waxing mighty in his body, the bountiful one filled both heaven and earth.

sanskrit: ma̱khasya̍ te tavi̱ṣasya̱ pra jū̱tim iya̍rmi̱ vāca̍m a̱mṛtā̍ya̱ bhūṣa̍n | indra̍ kṣitī̱nām a̍si̱ mānu̍ṣīṇāṁ vi̱śāṁ daivī̍nām u̱ta pū̍rva̱yāvā̍ ||
english: I send forth speech proclaiming the onset of you, the vigorous, the spirited, adorning it for immortal glory. O Indra, you are the foremost of human settlements, and you marched ahead even of the divine hosts.

sanskrit: indro̍ vṛ̱tram a̍vṛṇo̱c chardha̍nīti̱ḥ pra mā̱yinā̍m aminā̱d varpa̍ṇītiḥ | aha̱n vya̍ṁsam u̱śadha̱g vane̍ṣv ā̱vir dhenā̍ akṛṇod rā̱myāṇā̍m ||
english: Indra uncovered Vṛtra, irresistible in onslaught; he broke down the magic forms of the wily ones. He smote the broad-shouldered Vyaṁsa eagerly in the forests and made the cows of those who dwell afar manifest.

sanskrit: indra̍ḥ sva̱rṣā ja̱naya̱nn ahā̍ni ji̱gāyo̱śigbhi̱ḥ pṛta̍nā abhi̱ṣṭiḥ ||pra̱ro̍caya̱n mana̍ve ke̱tum ahnā̱m avi̍nda̱j jyoti̍r bṛha̱te raṇā̍ya ||
english: Indra, winning the sun, engendering the days, conquering battles with inspired men, his onslaught victorious — lighting up for Manu the banner of the dawns, he found light for the great contest.

sanskrit: indra̱s tujo̍ ba̱rhaṇā̱ ā vi̍veśa nṛ̱vad dadhā̍no̱ naryā̍ pu̱rūṇi̍ | ace̍taya̱d dhiya̍ i̱mā ja̍ri̱tre premaṁ varṇa̍m atirac chu̱kram ā̍sām ||
english: Indra, pressing powerfully, entered with vigor, bearing many manly things as a man. He illumined these thoughts for the singer and surpassed with this brilliant color those others.

sanskrit: ma̱ho ma̱hāni̍ panayanty a̱syendra̍sya̱ karma̱ sukṛ̍tā pu̱rūṇi̍ | vṛ̱jane̍na vṛji̱nān sam pi̍peṣa mā̱yābhi̱r dasyū̍m̐r a̱bhibhū̍tyojāḥ ||
english: His great and many well-wrought deeds of Indra's are worthy of wonder. He crushed the wicked with the enclosure; with superior might and power he overwhelmed the Dasyus with his magic arts.

sanskrit: yu̱dhendro̍ ma̱hnā vari̍vaś cakāra de̱vebhya̱ḥ satpa̍tiś carṣaṇi̱prāḥ ||vi̱vasva̍ta̱ḥ sada̍ne asya̱ tāni̱ viprā̍ u̱kthebhi̍ḥ ka̱vayo̍ gṛṇanti ||
english: In battle, Indra, the lord of the good, the guardian of men, made wide room by his greatness for the gods. The inspired sages and seers proclaim those deeds of his in the seat of Vivasvat with their hymns.

sanskrit: sa̱trā̱sāha̱ṁ vare̍ṇyaṁ saho̱dāṁ sa̍sa̱vāṁsa̱ṁ sva̍r a̱paś ca̍ de̱vīḥ | sa̱sāna̱ yaḥ pṛ̍thi̱vīṁ dyām u̱temām indra̍m mada̱nty anu̱ dhīra̍ṇāsaḥ ||
english: The one who won all-subjugating, excellent, strength-giving gifts — who won the sun and the divine waters — who won this earth and heaven: the wise ones exult after Indra.

sanskrit: sa̱sānātyā̍m̐ u̱ta sūrya̍ṁ sasā̱nendra̍ḥ sasāna puru̱bhoja̍sa̱ṁ gām | hi̱ra̱ṇyaya̍m u̱ta bhoga̍ṁ sasāna ha̱tvī dasyū̱n prārya̱ṁ varṇa̍m āvat ||
english: He won the swift horses, Indra won the sun, he won the cow that gives rich nourishment, he won golden treasure and enjoyment — having slain the Dasyus, he protected the Āryan color.

sanskrit: indra̱ oṣa̍dhīr asano̱d ahā̍ni̱ vana̱patī̍m̐r asanod a̱ntari̍kṣam | bi̱bheda̍ va̱laṁ nu̍nu̱de vivā̱co 'thā̍bhavad dami̱tābhikra̍tūnām ||
english: Indra won the herbs, he won the days and the lords of the forest, he won the atmosphere. He cleft open the Vala cave, drove away the Vivācs, and became the tamer of those who opposed him.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ hu̍vema ma̱ghavā̍na̱m indra̍m a̱smin bhare̱ nṛta̍ma̱ṁ vāja̍sātau | śṛ̱ṇvanta̍m u̱gram ū̱taye̍ sa̱matsu̱ ghnanta̍ṁ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ sa̱ṁjita̱ṁ dhanā̍nām ||
english: May we invoke for our well-being the bountiful Indra, most manly in this battle, in the contest for the prize — him who listens, the fierce one for help in combats, who slays the obstructions and wins the wealth.

sanskrit: tiṣṭhā̱ harī̱ ratha̱ ā yu̱jyamā̍nā yā̱hi vā̱yur na ni̱yuto̍ no̱ accha̍ | pibā̱sy andho̍ a̱bhisṛ̍ṣṭo a̱sme indra̱ svāhā̍ rari̱mā te̱ madā̍ya ||
english: Stand, O bay steeds, being yoked to the chariot! Come to us like Vāyu with his teams. Drink of the Soma poured forth for us — O Indra, svāhā! We have offered it to you for your exhilaration.

sanskrit: upā̍ji̱rā pu̍ruhū̱tāya̱ saptī̱ harī̱ ratha̍sya dhū̱rṣv ā yu̍najmi | dra̱vad yathā̱ sambhṛ̍taṁ vi̱śvata̍ś ci̱d upe̱maṁ ya̱jñam ā va̍hāta̱ indra̍m ||
english: I yoke the swift bay horses, the two bays of the chariot-pole, for the much-invoked one. May they bring Indra hither to this sacrifice, swiftly, as one gathers gathered riches from all sides.

sanskrit: upo̍ nayasva̱ vṛṣa̍ṇā tapu̱ṣpotem a̍va̱ tvaṁ vṛ̍ṣabha svadhāvaḥ | grase̍tā̱m aśvā̱ vi mu̍ce̱ha śoṇā̍ di̱ve-di̍ve sa̱dṛśī̍r addhi dhā̱nāḥ ||
english: Lead the two powerful males near, O lord of self-power, and look down, O bull! Let the horses eat here, the red ones set free — eat the like-and-equal grain day by day.

sanskrit: brahma̍ṇā te brahma̱yujā̍ yunajmi̱ harī̱ sakhā̍yā sadha̱māda̍ ā̱śū | sthi̱raṁ ratha̍ṁ su̱kham i̍ndrādhi̱tiṣṭha̍n prajā̱nan vi̱dvām̐ upa̍ yāhi̱ soma̍m ||
english: With sacred prayer I yoke your two swift bay companions who exult together, yoked by holy prayer. Mounting the firm and comfortable chariot, knowing all, as one who understands, come to the Soma.

sanskrit: mā te̱ harī̱ vṛṣa̍ṇā vī̱tapṛ̍ṣṭhā̱ ni rī̍rama̱n yaja̍māno a̱nye | a̱tyāyā̍hi̱ śaśva̍to va̱yaṁ te 'ra̍ṁ su̱tebhi̍ḥ kṛṇavāma̱ somai̍ḥ ||
english: May your two bull bays with resplendent backs not be detained by other sacrificers. Come past them all to us who always call — we shall make ourselves fit for you with pressed Soma draughts.

sanskrit: tavā̱yaṁ soma̱s tvam ehy a̱rvāṅ cha̍śvatta̱maṁ su̱manā̍ a̱sya pā̍hi | a̱smin ya̱jñe ba̱rhiṣy ā ni̱ṣadyā̍ dadhi̱ṣvemaṁ ja̱ṭhara̱ indu̍m indra ||
english: This Soma is yours — come hither! Drink of it ever and again with a glad heart. Sit down upon the sacred grass at this sacrifice and hold this Soma-drop in your belly, O Indra.

sanskrit: stī̱rṇaṁ te̍ ba̱rhiḥ su̱ta i̍ndra̱ soma̍ḥ kṛ̱tā dhā̱nā atta̍ve te̱ hari̍bhyām | tado̍kase puru̱śākā̍ya̱ vṛṣṇe̍ ma̱rutva̍te̱ tubhya̍ṁ rā̱tā ha̱vīṁṣi̍ ||
english: The sacred grass is strewn for you, O Indra; the Soma is pressed; the roasted grain is made ready for your bays to eat. To you, who dwell in that home, the mighty bull attended by the Maruts, the oblations are offered.

sanskrit: i̱maṁ nara̱ḥ parva̍tā̱s tubhya̱m āpa̱ḥ sam i̍ndra̱ gobhi̱r madhu̍mantam akran | tasyā̱gatyā̍ su̱manā̍ ṛṣva pāhi prajā̱nan vi̱dvān pa̱thyā̱3̱̍ anu̱ svāḥ ||
english: These men, the mountains, and the waters, O Indra, have mingled it sweet with milk for you. Come to it with a glad heart, O tall one, and drink, knowing your own right paths as one who understands.

sanskrit: yām̐ ābha̍jo ma̱ruta̍ indra̱ some̱ ye tvām ava̍rdha̱nn abha̍van ga̱ṇas te̍ | tebhi̍r e̱taṁ sa̱joṣā̍ vāvaśā̱no̱3̱̍ 'gneḥ pi̍ba ji̱hvayā̱ soma̍m indra ||
english: Those Maruts whom you, O Indra, shared in Soma, who strengthened you and became your troop — rejoicing along with them, eager and desirous, drink this Soma with the tongue of Agni, O Indra.

sanskrit: indra̱ piba̍ sva̱dhayā̍ cit su̱tasyā̱gner vā̍ pāhi ji̱hvayā̍ yajatra | a̱dhva̱ryor vā̱ praya̍taṁ śakra̱ hastā̱d dhotu̍r vā ya̱jñaṁ ha̱viṣo̍ juṣasva ||
english: O Indra, drink of the pressed Soma even with sovereign joy, or drink with the tongue of Agni, O adorable one. Or take the gift from the adhvaryus' hands, O mighty one, or enjoy the sacrifice and oblation of the hotar.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ hu̍vema ma̱ghavā̍na̱m indra̍m a̱smin bhare̱ nṛta̍ma̱ṁ vāja̍sātau | śṛ̱ṇvanta̍m u̱gram ū̱taye̍ sa̱matsu̱ ghnanta̍ṁ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ sa̱ṁjita̱ṁ dhanā̍nām ||
english: May we invoke for our well-being the bountiful Indra, most manly in this battle, in the contest for the prize — him who listens, the fierce one for help in combats, who slays the obstructions and wins the wealth.

sanskrit: i̱mām ū̱ ṣu prabhṛ̍tiṁ sā̱taye̍ dhā̱ḥ śaśva̍c-chaśvad ū̱tibhi̱r yāda̍mānaḥ | su̱te-su̍te vāvṛdhe̱ vardha̍nebhi̱r yaḥ karma̍bhir ma̱hadbhi̱ḥ suśru̍to̱ bhūt ||
english: Place this offering for the winning, O Indra, ever seeking us with your constant aids. He who is celebrated by great deeds has waxed great through magnifications at each pressing.

sanskrit: indrā̍ya̱ somā̍ḥ pra̱divo̱ vidā̍nā ṛ̱bhur yebhi̱r vṛṣa̍parvā̱ vihā̍yāḥ | pra̱ya̱myamā̍nā̱n prati̱ ṣū gṛ̍bhā̱yendra̱ piba̱ vṛṣa̍dhūtasya̱ vṛṣṇa̍ḥ ||
english: The Soma presses have been known from of old for Indra — the skilled one who mounts the cloud-peaks in flight. Grasp what is being poured out, O Indra; drink of the bull's Soma, shaken by the bull.

sanskrit: pibā̱ vardha̍sva̱ tava̍ ghā su̱tāsa̱ indra̱ somā̍saḥ pratha̱mā u̱teme | yathāpi̍baḥ pū̱rvyām̐ i̍ndra̱ somā̍m̐ e̱vā pā̍hi̱ panyo̍ a̱dyā navī̍yān ||
english: Drink and grow, O Indra — indeed these pressed Somas are yours, both the first ones and these. Just as you drank the primordial Somas, O Indra, so drink now the admirable, the newer one.

sanskrit: ma̱hām̐ ama̍tro vṛ̱jane̍ vira̱pśy u1̱̍graṁ śava̍ḥ patyate dhṛ̱ṣṇv oja̍ḥ | nāha̍ vivyāca pṛthi̱vī ca̱naina̱ṁ yat somā̍so̱ harya̍śva̱m ama̍ndan ||
english: Great is the drinking-vessel in the fold, overflowing; fierce power prevails, bold might. Not even the earth could contain him when the Soma draughts exhilarate him of the bay horses.

sanskrit: ma̱hām̐ u̱gro vā̍vṛdhe vī̱ryā̍ya sa̱māca̍kre vṛṣa̱bhaḥ kāvye̍na | indro̱ bhago̍ vāja̱dā a̍sya̱ gāva̱ḥ pra jā̍yante̱ dakṣi̍ṇā asya pū̱rvīḥ ||
english: The great, the fierce one has grown for heroic power; the bull has fully readied himself with poetic wisdom. Indra is fortune; his prize-winning cows are born; his gifts and rewards are many.

sanskrit: pra yat sindha̍vaḥ prasa̱vaṁ yathāya̱nn āpa̍ḥ samu̱draṁ ra̱thye̍va jagmuḥ | ata̍ś ci̱d indra̱ḥ sada̍so̱ varī̍yā̱n yad ī̱ṁ soma̍ḥ pṛ̱ṇati̍ du̱gdho a̱ṁśuḥ ||
english: When the rivers sped forth in their onward flow, the waters went like chariot-wheels to the ocean — yet from that seat Indra is yet more exalted when the milked Soma-stalk sates him.

sanskrit: sa̱mu̱dreṇa̱ sindha̍vo̱ yāda̍mānā̱ indrā̍ya̱ soma̱ṁ suṣu̍ta̱m bhara̍ntaḥ | a̱ṁśuṁ du̍hanti ha̱stino̍ bha̱ritrai̱r madhva̍ḥ punanti̱ dhāra̍yā pa̱vitrai̍ḥ ||
english: The rivers flowing to the ocean, bearing well-pressed Soma for Indra — the hand-wielded pressing-stones milk the Soma-stalk; they purify it with a stream of sweetness through filters.

sanskrit: hra̱dā i̍va ku̱kṣaya̍ḥ soma̱dhānā̱ḥ sam ī̍ vivyāca̱ sava̍nā pu̱rūṇi̍ | annā̱ yad indra̍ḥ pratha̱mā vy āśa̍ vṛ̱traṁ ja̍gha̱nvām̐ a̍vṛṇīta̱ soma̍m ||
english: Like lake-like receptacles holding the Soma, the many pressings filled him full. When Indra first consumed the food — having slain Vṛtra — he chose the Soma.

sanskrit: ā tū bha̍ra̱ māki̍r e̱tat pari̍ ṣṭhād vi̱dmā hi tvā̱ vasu̍pati̱ṁ vasū̍nām | indra̱ yat te̱ māhi̍na̱ṁ datra̱m asty a̱smabhya̱ṁ tad dha̍ryaśva̱ pra ya̍ndhi ||
english: Bring it here — let no one keep it from you! For we know you as the lord of riches. O Indra, whatever great gift of yours exists, grant that to us, O you of the bay horses.

sanskrit: a̱sme pra ya̍ndhi maghavann ṛjīṣi̱nn indra̍ rā̱yo vi̱śvavā̍rasya̱ bhūre̍ḥ | a̱sme śa̱taṁ śa̱rado̍ jī̱vase̍ dhā a̱sme vī̱rāñ chaśva̍ta indra śiprin ||
english: Grant to us, O bountiful Indra, lord of the Soma-drops, wealth of all excellence in abundance. Grant us a hundred autumns to live, O Indra of the nose-ring — grant us heroes perpetually.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ hu̍vema ma̱ghavā̍na̱m indra̍m a̱smin bhare̱ nṛta̍ma̱ṁ vāja̍sātau | śṛ̱ṇvanta̍m u̱gram ū̱taye̍ sa̱matsu̱ ghnanta̍ṁ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ sa̱ṁjita̱ṁ dhanā̍nām ||
english: May we invoke for our well-being the bountiful Indra, most manly in this battle, in the contest for the prize — him who listens, the fierce one for help in combats, who slays the obstructions and wins the wealth.

sanskrit: vārtra̍hatyāya̱ śava̍se pṛtanā̱ṣāhyā̍ya ca | indra̱ tvā va̍rtayāmasi ||
english: For the slaying of Vṛtra, for might and for the conquest of armies, O Indra, we set you in motion.

sanskrit: a̱rvā̱cīna̱ṁ su te̱ mana̍ u̱ta cakṣu̍ḥ śatakrato | indra̍ kṛ̱ṇvantu̍ vā̱ghata̍ḥ ||
english: Turn your mind and your eye hither to us, O Śatakratu; may the praisers make that for you, O Indra.

sanskrit: nāmā̍ni te śatakrato̱ viśvā̍bhir gī̱rbhir ī̍mahe | indrā̍bhimāti̱ṣāhye̍ ||
english: We seek your names, O Śatakratu, with all our songs, O Indra, in the conquest of those who hate us.

sanskrit: pu̱ru̱ṣṭu̱tasya̱ dhāma̍bhiḥ śa̱tena̍ mahayāmasi | indra̍sya carṣaṇī̱dhṛta̍ḥ ||
english: With a hundred dwelling-places of the much-praised one we magnify him — Indra, who upholds the clans.

sanskrit: indra̍ṁ vṛ̱trāya̱ hanta̍ve puruhū̱tam upa̍ bruve | bhare̍ṣu̱ vāja̍sātaye ||
english: I invoke the much-called Indra for the slaying of Vṛtra, for the winning of the prize in battles.

sanskrit: vāje̍ṣu sāsa̱hir bha̍va̱ tvām ī̍mahe śatakrato | indra̍ vṛ̱trāya̱ hanta̍ve ||
english: Be ever victorious in battles — we seek you, O Śatakratu, O Indra, for the slaying of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: dyu̱mneṣu̍ pṛta̱nājye̍ pṛtsu̱tūrṣu̱ śrava̍ḥsu ca | indra̱ sākṣvā̱bhimā̍tiṣu ||
english: In glorious battles, in combats, in contests for fame, O Indra, conquer those who oppose us.

sanskrit: śu̱ṣminta̍maṁ na ū̱taye̍ dyu̱mnina̍m pāhi̱ jāgṛ̍vim | indra̱ soma̍ṁ śatakrato ||
english: Most impetuous and glorious, keep watch over the Soma for our aid, O Indra, O Śatakratu.

sanskrit: i̱ndri̱yāṇi̍ śatakrato̱ yā te̱ jane̍ṣu pa̱ñcasu̍ | indra̱ tāni̍ ta̱ ā vṛ̍ṇe ||
english: The Indra-powers which are yours among the five peoples, O Śatakratu — O Indra, those of yours I here choose.

sanskrit: aga̍nn indra̱ śravo̍ bṛ̱had dyu̱mnaṁ da̍dhiṣva du̱ṣṭara̍m | ut te̱ śuṣma̍ṁ tirāmasi ||
english: Gain great fame, O Indra! Establish glory that cannot be overcome. We exalt your power on high.

sanskrit: a̱rvā̱vato̍ na̱ ā ga̱hy atho̍ śakra parā̱vata̍ḥ | u̱ lo̱ko yas te̍ adriva̱ indre̱ha tata̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: Come to us from near, and also from afar, O mighty one. Whatever world is yours, O boulder-wielder, Indra, from that place come here to us.

sanskrit: a̱bhi taṣṭe̍va dīdhayā manī̱ṣām atyo̱ na vā̱jī su̱dhuro̱ jihā̍naḥ | a̱bhi pri̱yāṇi̱ marmṛ̍śa̱t parā̍ṇi ka̱vīm̐r i̍cchāmi sa̱ṁdṛśe̍ sume̱dhāḥ ||
english: I shall contemplate wisdom as if carving it; like a prize-winning horse well-harnessed and eager, I touch the beloved things and those beyond. Possessing good understanding, I wish to behold the seers.

sanskrit: i̱nota pṛ̍ccha̱ jani̍mā kavī̱nām ma̍no̱dhṛta̍ḥ su̱kṛta̍s takṣata̱ dyām | i̱mā u̍ te pra̱ṇyo̱3̱̍ vardha̍mānā̱ mano̍vātā̱ adha̱ nu dharma̍ṇi gman ||
english: Now ask of the births of the seers — the mind-firm, well-fashioning ones have carved the sky. These praises of yours, now growing, swift as mind and wind, have gone indeed upon the sacred law.

sanskrit: ni ṣī̱m id atra̱ guhyā̱ dadhā̍nā u̱ta kṣa̱trāya̱ roda̍sī̱ sam a̍ñjan | sam mātrā̍bhir mami̱re ye̱mur u̱rvī a̱ntar ma̱hī samṛ̍te̱ dhāya̍se dhuḥ ||
english: Laying down their hidden things here, they anointed both worlds together for power. They measured the wide ones with measures and held them firm; within the great pair they set the milch-cow for nourishment.

sanskrit: ā̱tiṣṭha̍nta̱m pari̱ viśve̍ abhūṣa̱ñ chriyo̱ vasā̍naś carati̱ svaro̍ciḥ ||ma̱hat tad vṛṣṇo̱ asu̍rasya̱ nāmā vi̱śvarū̍po a̱mṛtā̍ni tasthau ||
english: All beings adorned him as he stood firm; clothed in beauty, self-luminous he moves. Great is that name of the mighty lord; of all forms, he has stood firm in immortal things.

sanskrit: asū̍ta̱ pūrvo̍ vṛṣa̱bho jyāyā̍n i̱mā a̍sya śu̱rudha̍ḥ santi pū̱rvīḥ | divo̍ napātā vi̱dathe̍ṣu dhī̱bhiḥ kṣa̱traṁ rā̍jānā pra̱divo̍ dadhāthe ||
english: The elder bull brought forth a mightier; his overflows are many and primary. O sons of heaven — at the assemblies with prayers you two kings have established kingship from of old.

sanskrit: trīṇi̍ rājānā vi̱dathe̍ pu̱rūṇi̱ pari̱ viśvā̍ni bhūṣatha̱ḥ sadā̍ṁsi | apa̍śya̱m atra̱ mana̍sā jaga̱nvān vra̱te ga̍ndha̱rvām̐ api̍ vā̱yuke̍śān ||
english: Three, O kings, are the many seats of the assembly; you adorn them all. I who came here with mind saw among them the Gandharvas who perform vows, with wind-tossed hair.

sanskrit: tad in nv a̍sya vṛṣa̱bhasya̍ dhe̱nor ā nāma̍bhir mamire̱ sakmya̱ṁ goḥ | a̱nyad-a̍nyad asu̱rya1̱̍ṁ vasā̍nā̱ ni mā̱yino̍ mamire rū̱pam a̍smin ||
english: They measured out by names the fellowship of this bull's milch-cow. The lords of might, clothed in various forms, have laid down their magical shapes here, one after another.

sanskrit: tad in nv a̍sya savi̱tur naki̍r me hira̱ṇyayī̍m a̱mati̱ṁ yām aśi̍śret | ā su̍ṣṭu̱tī roda̍sī viśvami̱nve apī̍va̱ yoṣā̱ jani̍māni vavre ||
english: That golden thought of Savitṛ — no one for me has stretched it out fully as he has. Heaven and earth resound throughout with his excellent praise; like a woman, he has covered the births.

sanskrit: yu̱vam pra̱tnasya̍ sādhatho ma̱ho yad daivī̍ sva̱stiḥ pari̍ ṇaḥ syātam | go̱pāji̍hvasya ta̱sthuṣo̱ virū̍pā̱ viśve̍ paśyanti mā̱yina̍ḥ kṛ̱tāni̍ ||
english: You two accomplish the ancient great one's work, so that the divine boon of well-being may be around us. All the magical ones behold the manifold deeds of the standing cow-tongued one.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ hu̍vema ma̱ghavā̍na̱m indra̍m a̱smin bhare̱ nṛta̍ma̱ṁ vāja̍sātau | śṛ̱ṇvanta̍m u̱gram ū̱taye̍ sa̱matsu̱ ghnanta̍ṁ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ sa̱ṁjita̱ṁ dhanā̍nām ||
english: May we invoke for our well-being the bountiful Indra, most manly in this battle, in the contest for the prize — him who listens, the fierce one for help in combats, who slays the obstructions and wins the wealth.

sanskrit: indra̍m ma̱tir hṛ̱da ā va̱cyamā̱nācchā̱ pati̱ṁ stoma̍taṣṭā jigāti | yā jāgṛ̍vir vi̱dathe̍ śa̱syamā̱nendra̱ yat te̱ jāya̍te vi̱ddhi tasya̍ ||
english: Prayer spoken from the heart goes toward Indra, the lord, shaped into praise. That which, ever-wakeful, is being proclaimed in the assembly, O Indra — know it as born of you.

sanskrit: di̱vaś ci̱d ā pū̱rvyā jāya̍mānā̱ vi jāgṛ̍vir vi̱dathe̍ śa̱syamā̍nā | bha̱drā vastrā̱ṇy arju̍nā̱ vasā̍nā̱ seyam a̱sme sa̍na̱jā pitryā̱ dhīḥ ||
english: Coming from heaven even as primordial ones, wakeful and being proclaimed in the assembly, clothed in bright and fair garments — this is our ancient paternal wisdom.

sanskrit: ya̱mā ci̱d atra̍ yama̱sūr a̍sūta ji̱hvāyā̱ agra̱m pata̱d ā hy asthā̍t | vapū̍ṁṣi jā̱tā mi̍thu̱nā sa̍cete tamo̱hanā̱ tapu̍ṣo bu̱dhna etā̍ ||
english: Even what the mother of Yama bore here — the foremost fell from the tongue, for it has stood forth. The forms born as twins go together; these burn darkness from the base of the blazing fire.

sanskrit: naki̍r eṣāṁ nindi̱tā martye̍ṣu̱ ye a̱smāka̍m pi̱taro̱ goṣu̍ yo̱dhāḥ ||indra̍ eṣāṁ dṛṁhi̱tā māhi̍nāvā̱n ud go̱trāṇi̍ sasṛje da̱ṁsanā̍vān ||
english: None of those fathers of ours who were fighters for the cows are to be blamed among mortals. Indra their strengthener, of great power, opened the cow-pens by his wondrous deeds.

sanskrit: sakhā̍ ha̱ yatra̱ sakhi̍bhi̱r nava̍gvair abhi̱jñv ā satva̍bhi̱r gā a̍nu̱gman | sa̱tyaṁ tad indro̍ da̱śabhi̱r daśa̍gvai̱ḥ sūrya̍ṁ viveda̱ tama̍si kṣi̱yanta̍m ||
english: Where as a friend, with the Navagva friends, the knowers followed the cows with the warriors — truly then Indra, together with the ten Daśagvas, found the sun dwelling in darkness.

sanskrit: indro̱ madhu̱ sambhṛ̍tam u̱sriyā̍yām pa̱dvad vi̍veda śa̱phava̱n name̱ goḥ | guhā̍ hi̱taṁ guhya̍ṁ gū̱ḻham a̱psu haste̍ dadhe̱ dakṣi̍ṇe̱ dakṣi̍ṇāvān ||
english: Indra found the honey gathered in the dawn-cow — what had feet, what had hooves, what could bow the neck of the cow. He placed what was hidden, the secret, concealed in the waters, in his right hand, he of the right hand.

sanskrit: jyoti̍r vṛṇīta̱ tama̍so vijā̱nann ā̱re syā̍ma duri̱tād a̱bhīke̍ | i̱mā gira̍ḥ somapāḥ somavṛddha ju̱ṣasve̍ndra puru̱tama̍sya kā̱roḥ ||
english: He chose the light, distinguishing it from darkness; may we be far from adversity when near. Be pleased with these songs, O drinker of Soma, O one magnified by Soma, O Indra, of the singer's many offerings.

sanskrit: jyoti̍r ya̱jñāya̱ roda̍sī̱ anu̍ ṣyād ā̱re syā̍ma duri̱tasya̱ bhūre̍ḥ | bhūri̍ ci̱d dhi tu̍ja̱to martya̍sya supā̱rāso̍ vasavo ba̱rhaṇā̍vat ||
english: Light shall attend the sacrifice along heaven and earth; may we be far from many misfortunes. For even of a mortal who presses on, the Vasus are easy to cross by their great power.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ hu̍vema ma̱ghavā̍na̱m indra̍m a̱smin bhare̱ nṛta̍ma̱ṁ vāja̍sātau | śṛ̱ṇvanta̍m u̱gram ū̱taye̍ sa̱matsu̱ ghnanta̍ṁ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ sa̱ṁjita̱ṁ dhanā̍nām ||
english: May we invoke for our well-being the bountiful Indra, most manly in this battle, in the contest for the prize — him who listens, the fierce one for help in combats, who slays the obstructions and wins the wealth.

sanskrit: indra̍ tvā vṛṣa̱bhaṁ va̱yaṁ su̱te some̍ havāmahe | sa pā̍hi̱ madhvo̱ andha̍saḥ ||
english: O Indra, we call upon you, the bull, at the pressed Soma. Drink then of the sweet Soma-plant.

sanskrit: indra̍ kratu̱vida̍ṁ su̱taṁ soma̍ṁ harya puruṣṭuta | pibā vṛ̍ṣasva̱ tātṛ̍pim ||
english: O Indra, be pleased with the pressed Soma that knows the work, O much-praised one. Drink, O bull, your fill.

sanskrit: indra̱ pra ṇo̍ dhi̱tāvā̍naṁ ya̱jñaṁ viśve̍bhir de̱vebhi̍ḥ | ti̱ra sta̍vāna viśpate ||
english: O Indra, carry our devotional sacrifice forward with all the gods. Do bear it across, O praised lord of the folk.

sanskrit: indra̱ somā̍ḥ su̱tā i̱me tava̱ pra ya̍nti satpate | kṣaya̍ṁ ca̱ndrāsa̱ inda̍vaḥ ||
english: O Indra, these pressed Soma-drops advance toward you, O lord of the good — the bright shining drops to your abode.

sanskrit: da̱dhi̱ṣvā ja̱ṭhare̍ su̱taṁ soma̍m indra̱ vare̍ṇyam | tava̍ dyu̱kṣāsa̱ inda̍vaḥ ||
english: Hold the pressed, excellent Soma in your belly, O Indra. The drops that dwell in the sky are yours.

sanskrit: girva̍ṇaḥ pā̱hi na̍ḥ su̱tam madho̱r dhārā̍bhir ajyase | indra̱ tvādā̍ta̱m id yaśa̍ḥ ||
english: O you who delight in songs, drink our pressed Soma — you are anointed with streams of sweetness. The glory given by you, O Indra, is indeed ours.

sanskrit: a̱bhi dyu̱mnāni̍ va̱nina̱ indra̍ṁ sacante̱ akṣi̍tā | pī̱tvī soma̍sya vāvṛdhe ||
english: The inexhaustible glories like those of a forest accompany Indra. Having drunk of the Soma, he has grown great.

sanskrit: a̱rvā̱vato̍ na̱ ā ga̍hi parā̱vata̍ś ca vṛtrahan | i̱mā ju̍ṣasva no̱ gira̍ḥ ||
english: Come to us from near and from far, O Vṛtra-slayer. Be pleased with these our songs.

sanskrit: yad a̍nta̱rā pa̍rā̱vata̍m arvā̱vata̍ṁ ca hū̱yase̍ | indre̱ha tata̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: When you are called between the far and near, O Indra, from that place come here to us.

sanskrit: ā tū na̍ indra ma̱drya̍g ghuvā̱naḥ soma̍pītaye | hari̍bhyāṁ yāhy adrivaḥ ||
english: Come hither now, O Indra, turned benevolently toward us who call, for the drinking of Soma; come, O boulder-wielder, with your two bays.

sanskrit: sa̱tto hotā̍ na ṛ̱tviya̍s tisti̱re ba̱rhir ā̍nu̱ṣak | ayu̍jran prā̱tar adra̍yaḥ ||
english: Our seasonal hotar has sat down; the sacred grass is strewn in succession; in the morning the pressing-stones have been yoked.

sanskrit: i̱mā brahma̍ brahmavāhaḥ kri̱yanta̱ ā ba̱rhiḥ sī̍da | vī̱hi śū̍ra puro̱ḻāśa̍m ||
english: These sacred prayers are being made, O bearer of prayer. Sit down upon the sacred grass. O hero, enjoy the sacrificial cake.

sanskrit: rā̱ra̱ndhi sava̍neṣu ṇa e̱ṣu stome̍ṣu vṛtrahan | u̱ktheṣv i̍ndra girvaṇaḥ ||
english: Grant us success at these pressings, at these praises, O Vṛtra-slayer, at these hymns, O Indra who delights in songs.

sanskrit: ma̱taya̍ḥ soma̱pām u̱ruṁ ri̱hanti̱ śava̍sa̱s pati̍m | indra̍ṁ va̱tsaṁ na mā̱tara̍ḥ ||
english: Prayers lick Indra the wide Soma-drinker, the lord of might, as mothers lick a calf.

sanskrit: sa ma̍ndasvā̱ hy andha̍so̱ rādha̍se ta̱nvā̍ ma̱he | na sto̱tāra̍ṁ ni̱de ka̍raḥ ||
english: Be exhilarated by the Soma-plant for bounty, for the great one himself. Do not put the praiser to shame.

sanskrit: va̱yam i̍ndra tvā̱yavo̍ ha̱viṣma̍nto jarāmahe | u̱ta tvam a̍sma̱yur va̍so ||
english: We, longing for you, O Indra, bearing oblations, praise you. And you, O lord, desire us in return.

sanskrit: māre a̱smad vi mu̍muco̱ hari̍priyā̱rvāṅ yā̍hi | indra̍ svadhāvo̱ matsve̱ha ||
english: Do not release yourself away from us who love the bays — come hither! O Indra of sovereign power, be exhilarated here.

sanskrit: a̱rvāñca̍ṁ tvā su̱khe rathe̱ vaha̍tām indra ke̱śinā̍ | ghṛ̱tasnū̍ ba̱rhir ā̱sade̍ ||
english: May the two mane-horses, dripping ghee, bring you hitherward on the comfortable chariot, O Indra, to sit upon the sacred grass.

sanskrit: upa̍ naḥ su̱tam ā ga̍hi̱ soma̍m indra̱ gavā̍śiram | hari̍bhyā̱ṁ yas te̍ asma̱yuḥ ||
english: Come to our pressed Soma mixed with milk, O Indra, with your two bays that desire us.

sanskrit: tam i̍ndra̱ mada̱m ā ga̍hi barhi̱ḥṣṭhāṁ grāva̍bhiḥ su̱tam | ku̱vin nv a̍sya tṛ̱pṇava̍ḥ ||
english: Come to that exhilaration, O Indra, to what is pressed on the sacred grass with the pressing-stones. Will you now be fully satisfied with it?

sanskrit: indra̍m i̱tthā giro̱ mamācchā̍gur iṣi̱tā i̱taḥ | ā̱vṛte̱ soma̍pītaye ||
english: My songs thus directed go toward Indra, sent from here. For his return, for the drinking of Soma.

sanskrit: indra̱ṁ soma̍sya pī̱taye̱ stomai̍r i̱ha ha̍vāmahe | u̱kthebhi̍ḥ ku̱vid ā̱gama̍t ||
english: For the drinking of Soma we here invoke Indra with praises and with hymns. Will he now come?

sanskrit: indra̱ somā̍ḥ su̱tā i̱me tān da̍dhiṣva śatakrato | ja̱ṭhare̍ vājinīvaso ||
english: O Indra, these Soma-drops are pressed — hold them in your belly, O Śatakratu, O lord of the prize-winning company.

sanskrit: vi̱dmā hi tvā̍ dhanaṁja̱yaṁ vāje̍ṣu dadhṛ̱ṣaṁ ka̍ve | adhā̍ te su̱mnam ī̍mahe ||
english: For we know you as the winner of riches, O seer, bold in contests. So we seek your benevolence.

sanskrit: i̱mam i̍ndra̱ gavā̍śira̱ṁ yavā̍śiraṁ ca naḥ piba | ā̱gatyā̱ vṛṣa̍bhiḥ su̱tam ||
english: Drink this Soma of ours mixed with milk, and that mixed with barley, O Indra — the pressed draught with the bulls coming to it.

sanskrit: tubhyed i̍ndra̱ sva o̱kye̱3̱̍ soma̍ṁ codāmi pī̱taye̍ | e̱ṣa rā̍rantu te hṛ̱di ||
english: For you, O Indra, in your own home, I urge the Soma for drinking. Let this one delight your heart.

sanskrit: tvāṁ su̱tasya̍ pī̱taye̍ pra̱tnam i̍ndra havāmahe | ku̱śi̱kāso̍ ava̱syava̍ḥ ||
english: We the Kuśikas, seeking aid, invoke you, O ancient Indra, for the drinking of the pressed Soma.

sanskrit: ā yā̍hy a̱rvāṅ upa̍ vandhure̱ṣṭhās taved anu̍ pra̱diva̍ḥ soma̱peya̍m | pri̱yā sakhā̍yā̱ vi mu̱copa̍ ba̱rhis tvām i̱me ha̍vya̱vāho̍ havante ||
english: Come hither, standing in the chariot-seat — from of old the Soma-drinking awaits you. The beloved friends are here; spread out the sacred grass. These fire-bearers call you.

sanskrit: ā yā̍hi pū̱rvīr ati̍ carṣa̱ṇīr ām̐ a̱rya ā̱śiṣa̱ upa̍ no̱ hari̍bhyām | i̱mā hi tvā̍ ma̱taya̱ḥ stoma̍taṣṭā̱ indra̱ hava̍nte sa̱khyaṁ ju̍ṣā̱ṇāḥ ||
english: Come past the many human settlements, O noble one, with your two bays and blessings upon us. For these prayers, shaped into praise, call you, O Indra, taking pleasure in friendship.

sanskrit: ā no̍ ya̱jñaṁ na̍mo̱vṛdha̍ṁ sa̱joṣā̱ indra̍ deva̱ hari̍bhir yāhi̱ tūya̍m | a̱haṁ hi tvā̍ ma̱tibhi̱r joha̍vīmi ghṛ̱tapra̍yāḥ sadha̱māde̱ madhū̍nām ||
english: Come swiftly to our sacrifice that increases through obeisance, O divine Indra, in accord with us and with your two bays. For I call you repeatedly with prayers, preceded by ghee, to the feast of sweetness.

sanskrit: ā ca̱ tvām e̱tā vṛṣa̍ṇā̱ vahā̍to̱ harī̱ sakhā̍yā su̱dhurā̱ svaṅgā̍ | dhā̱nāva̱d indra̱ḥ sava̍naṁ juṣā̱ṇaḥ sakhā̱ sakhyu̍ḥ śṛṇava̱d vanda̍nāni ||
english: May these two bulls, your bay companions, well-harnessed and well-limbed, bring you here. May Indra enjoying the pressing-feast with grain, as a friend may hear the songs of the friend.

sanskrit: ku̱vin mā̍ go̱pāṁ kara̍se̱ jana̍sya ku̱vid rājā̍nam maghavann ṛjīṣin | ku̱vin ma̱ ṛṣi̍m papi̱vāṁsa̍ṁ su̱tasya̍ ku̱vin me̱ vasvo̍ a̱mṛta̍sya̱ śikṣā̍ḥ ||
english: Will you make me guardian of the people? Will you, O bountiful Soma-lord, make me a king? Will you make me a seer who has drunk of the pressed Soma? Will you grant me your immortal wealth?

sanskrit: ā tvā̍ bṛ̱hanto̱ hara̍yo yujā̱nā a̱rvāg i̍ndra sadha̱mādo̍ vahantu | pra ye dvi̱tā di̱va ṛ̱ñjanty ātā̱ḥ susa̍mmṛṣṭāso vṛṣa̱bhasya̍ mū̱rāḥ ||
english: May the great bays, being yoked, bring you hither, O Indra, to the common feast — those who gleam high twice from heaven, well-adorned, the wise ones of the bull.

sanskrit: indra̱ piba̱ vṛṣa̍dhūtasya̱ vṛṣṇa̱ ā yaṁ te̍ śye̱na u̍śa̱te ja̱bhāra̍ | yasya̱ made̍ cyā̱vaya̍si̱ pra kṛ̱ṣṭīr yasya̱ made̱ apa̍ go̱trā va̱vartha̍ ||
english: O Indra, drink of the bull's Soma shaken by the bull, which the eager falcon brought to you — in whose exhilaration you shake the peoples forth, in whose exhilaration you opened the cow-pens.

sanskrit: śu̱naṁ hu̍vema ma̱ghavā̍na̱m indra̍m a̱smin bhare̱ nṛta̍ma̱ṁ vāja̍sātau | śṛ̱ṇvanta̍m u̱gram ū̱taye̍ sa̱matsu̱ ghnanta̍ṁ vṛ̱trāṇi̍ sa̱ṁjita̱ṁ dhanā̍nām ||
english: May we invoke for our well-being the bountiful Indra, most manly in this battle, in the contest for the prize — him who listens, the fierce one for help in combats, who slays the obstructions and wins the wealth.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ te̍ astu harya̱taḥ soma̱ ā hari̍bhiḥ su̱taḥ | ju̱ṣā̱ṇa i̍ndra̱ hari̍bhir na̱ ā ga̱hy ā ti̍ṣṭha̱ hari̍ta̱ṁ ratha̍m ||
english: May this Soma, desirable and pressed by the bays, be yours. Enjoying it with your bays, O Indra, come to us — mount the bay chariot.

sanskrit: ha̱ryann u̱ṣasa̍m arcaya̱ḥ sūrya̍ṁ ha̱ryann a̍rocayaḥ | vi̱dvām̐ś ci̍ki̱tvān ha̍ryaśva vardhasa̱ indra̱ viśvā̍ a̱bhi śriya̍ḥ ||
english: Delighting, you illumined the dawn; delighting, you made the sun shine. Knowing and discerning, O you of the bay horses, you grow great, O Indra, encompassing all glories.

sanskrit: dyām indro̱ hari̍dhāyasam pṛthi̱vīṁ hari̍varpasam | adhā̍rayad dha̱rito̱r bhūri̱ bhoja̍na̱ṁ yayo̍r a̱ntar hari̱ś cara̍t ||
english: Indra upheld the sky with the bay's brilliance, the earth with bay-colored form. Between those two the green one moves with abundant nourishment of the bays.

sanskrit: ja̱jñā̱no hari̍to̱ vṛṣā̱ viśva̱m ā bhā̍ti roca̱nam | harya̍śvo̱ hari̍taṁ dhatta̱ āyu̍dha̱m ā vajra̍m bā̱hvor hari̍m ||
english: Born as the golden-green bull, he illumines all the luminous realm. The bay-horsed one holds the golden-green weapon — the green thunderbolt in his arms.

sanskrit: indro̍ ha̱ryanta̱m arju̍na̱ṁ vajra̍ṁ śu̱krair a̱bhīvṛ̍tam | apā̍vṛṇo̱d dhari̍bhi̱r adri̍bhiḥ su̱tam ud gā hari̍bhir ājata ||
english: Indra, who loves the gleaming, bright thunderbolt enveloped with bright rays — uncovering it with his bays and the pressing-stones, he pressed the Soma and drove the cows up with his bays.

sanskrit: ā ma̱ndrair i̍ndra̱ hari̍bhir yā̱hi ma̱yūra̍romabhiḥ | mā tvā̱ ke ci̱n ni ya̍ma̱n viṁ na pā̱śino 'ti̱ dhanve̍va̱ tām̐ i̍hi ||
english: Come, O Indra, with your pleasing bays with peacock-feather manes! Let no one hold you back — like a bird past the snare, go past them as over a desert.

sanskrit: vṛ̱tra̱khā̱do va̍laṁru̱jaḥ pu̱rāṁ da̱rmo a̱pām a̱jaḥ | sthātā̱ ratha̍sya̱ haryo̍r abhisva̱ra indro̍ dṛ̱ḻhā ci̍d āru̱jaḥ ||
english: The eater of Vṛtra, the breaker of Vala, the destroyer of forts, the driver of waters — the charioteer standing with the two bays, roaring onward, Indra, the smasher even of the firm.

sanskrit: ga̱mbhī̱rām̐ u̍da̱dhīm̐r i̍va̱ kratu̍m puṣyasi̱ gā i̍va | pra su̍go̱pā yava̍saṁ dhe̱navo̍ yathā hra̱daṁ ku̱lyā i̍vāśata ||
english: You nourish wisdom as if filling deep seas, you nourish the cows. Well-guarded, they reach the pasture as cows reach a pond, as streams a lake.

sanskrit: ā na̱s tuja̍ṁ ra̱yim bha̱rāṁśa̱ṁ na pra̍tijāna̱te | vṛ̱kṣam pa̱kvam phala̍m a̱ṅkīva̍ dhūnu̱hīndra̍ sa̱mpāra̍ṇa̱ṁ vasu̍ ||
english: Bring us driving wealth — a share not recognized by others. Shake the ripe fruit from the tree as if with a hook, O Indra — the carrying-across wealth.

sanskrit: sva̱yur i̍ndra sva̱rāḻ a̍si̱ smaddi̍ṣṭi̱ḥ svaya̍śastaraḥ | sa vā̍vṛdhā̱na oja̍sā puruṣṭuta̱ bhavā̍ naḥ su̱śrava̍stamaḥ ||
english: Self-willed, O Indra, you are self-ruling, aiming well, more self-glorious. Waxing great in might, O much-praised one, be the best known to fame for us.

sanskrit: yu̱dhmasya̍ te vṛṣa̱bhasya̍ sva̱rāja̍ u̱grasya̱ yūna̱ḥ sthavi̍rasya̱ ghṛṣve̍ḥ | ajū̍ryato va̱jriṇo̍ vī̱ryā̱3̱̍ṇīndra̍ śru̱tasya̍ maha̱to ma̱hāni̍ ||
english: Great are the heroic deeds of you, O Indra, the combative, the bull, the self-king, the fierce, the youthful, the strong, the vigorous, the unaging wielder of the thunderbolt, the famous, the great one.

sanskrit: ma̱hām̐ a̍si mahiṣa̱ vṛṣṇye̍bhir dhana̱spṛd u̍gra̱ saha̍māno a̱nyān | eko̱ viśva̍sya̱ bhuva̍nasya̱ rājā̱ sa yo̱dhayā̍ ca kṣa̱yayā̍ ca̱ janā̍n ||
english: You are great, O buffalo-bull, by your bull-like powers — O fierce one who overwhelms others, winning wealth. You alone are king of the whole world; you set the peoples to war and to settlement.

sanskrit: pra mātrā̍bhī ririce̱ roca̍māna̱ḥ pra de̱vebhi̍r vi̱śvato̱ apra̍tītaḥ | pra ma̱jmanā̍ di̱va indra̍ḥ pṛthi̱vyāḥ proror ma̱ho a̱ntari̍kṣād ṛjī̱ṣī ||
english: He shines forth beyond measure, radiant; beyond the gods in every direction, unrivaled. Indra surpasses by his greatness sky and earth; the Soma-drinker surpasses the vast great atmosphere.

sanskrit: u̱ruṁ ga̍bhī̱raṁ ja̱nuṣā̱bhy u1̱̍graṁ vi̱śvavya̍casam ava̱tam ma̍tī̱nām | indra̱ṁ somā̍saḥ pra̱divi̍ su̱tāsa̍ḥ samu̱draṁ na sra̱vata̱ ā vi̍śanti ||
english: Wide, deep, fierce from birth, of universal reach, the refuge of prayers — into Indra the Somas pressed from of old flow and enter as rivers into the sea.

sanskrit: yaṁ soma̍m indra pṛthi̱vīdyāvā̱ garbha̱ṁ na mā̍tā bi̍bhṛ̱tas tvā̱yā | taṁ te̍ hinvanti̱ tam u̍ te mṛjanty adhva̱ryavo̍ vṛṣabha̱ pāta̱vā u̍ ||
english: That Soma which the earth and heaven carry for you as a mother carries an embryo for the sake of you, O Indra — that the adhvaryus send for you, they cleanse it for you too, O bull, for the drinking.

sanskrit: ma̱rutvā̍m̐ indra vṛṣa̱bho raṇā̍ya̱ pibā̱ soma̍m anuṣva̱dham madā̍ya | ā si̍ñcasva ja̱ṭhare̱ madhva̍ ū̱rmiṁ tvaṁ rājā̍si pra̱diva̍ḥ su̱tānā̍m ||
english: O Indra, bull attended by the Maruts, drink the Soma for battle, drink of your own nature for exhilaration. Pour the sweet wave into your belly — you are the king from of old of the pressed Somas.

sanskrit: sa̱joṣā̍ indra̱ saga̍ṇo ma̱rudbhi̱ḥ soma̍m piba vṛtra̱hā śū̍ra vi̱dvān | ja̱hi śatrū̱m̐r apa̱ mṛdho̍ nuda̱svāthābha̍yaṁ kṛṇuhi vi̱śvato̍ naḥ ||
english: In accord, O Indra, in a troop together with the Maruts, drink the Soma, O Vṛtra-slayer, O hero, knowing all. Strike the enemies, drive back the despisers, and make us fearless on all sides.

sanskrit: u̱ta ṛ̱tubhi̍r ṛtupāḥ pāhi̱ soma̱m indra̍ de̱vebhi̱ḥ sakhi̍bhiḥ su̱taṁ na̍ḥ | yām̐ ābha̍jo ma̱ruto̱ ye tvānv aha̍n vṛ̱tram ada̍dhu̱s tubhya̱m oja̍ḥ ||
english: O guardian of the seasons, drink at the proper seasons our pressed Soma, O Indra, with the gods your companions. Those Maruts whom you shared, who followed you and slew Vṛtra — they gave their might to you.

sanskrit: ye tvā̍hi̱hatye̍ maghava̱nn ava̍rdha̱n ye śā̍mba̱re ha̍rivo̱ ye gavi̍ṣṭau | ye tvā̍ nū̱nam a̍nu̱mada̍nti̱ viprā̱ḥ pibe̍ndra̱ soma̱ṁ saga̍ṇo ma̱rudbhi̍ḥ ||
english: Those who strengthened you, O bountiful one, in the slaying of the serpent, who were with you in the slaying of Śambara, O bay-horsed one, who were with you in the winning of the cows, those inspired men who exult with you now — drink the Soma, O Indra, together with the Maruts.

sanskrit: ma̱rutva̍ntaṁ vṛṣa̱bhaṁ vā̍vṛdhā̱nam aka̍vāriṁ di̱vyaṁ śā̱sam indra̍m | vi̱śvā̱sāha̱m ava̍se̱ nūta̍nāyo̱graṁ sa̍ho̱dām i̱ha taṁ hu̍vema ||
english: We would here invoke for our protection the new-praising Indra attended by the Maruts — the bull who has grown great, the heavenly one of irresistible command, the all-conquering, the fierce giver of might.
